location.provenance: SECTION 8. ORS 459.995, as amended by section 15, chapter 102, Oregon Laws 2022, is amended to read:

status.provenance: The following summary is not prepared by the sponsors of the measure and is not a part of the body thereof subject to consideration by the Legislative Assembly.

date.provenance: SECTION 5. (1) The Department of Environmental Quality shall establish a certification program for compostable products. Subject to subsection (2) of this section, a person that meets the criteria established by the department may apply for authorization under the program to certify that products sold or offered for sale in this state are compostable.

pfas_definition.provenance: 'Perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substance' means a substance included in a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: Prohibits person from selling or distributing foodware containers containing perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substances.

who.provenance: Prohibits person from selling or distributing foodware containers containing perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substances.

action.provenance: A person may not sell, offer for sale, or distribute in or into this state a foodware container containing perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substances.
